description: A two-panel composite figure from a three-dimensional atom probe (3DAP) study of a high-Al low-density medium-Mn steel. (a) is a 3DAP reconstruction of the analysed conical tip: the vertical axis is labelled Z [nm] with ticks −50, −100, −150, −200, −250, −300, and the lateral axes are labelled Y [nm] and X [nm] (ticks spanning roughly −40 to 40 nm). A legend maps element colours: Fe (pink), Mn (yellow), Al (cyan), Si (white) and C (dark red). A light-blue virtual cylinder runs along the Z axis through the tip; a black dashed line at about Z = −50 nm marks the interface and a second dashed curve lies near Z = −250 nm. A 200 nm scale bar and a red annotation line frame the bottom-left of (a). (b) is the corresponding 1D concentration profile: y-axis "Concentration (atomic %)" 0–80, x-axis "Distance (nm)" 0–350, with curves for Fe %, Mn %, Al %, C % and Si %. Along the cylinder, Fe % holds near 74 up to ~240 nm, drops sharply to ~65 at ~245 nm then rises to ~78; Mn % simultaneously spikes to ~18 and then falls to ~6; Al % dips and then rises; C % peaks at the interface and drops to near zero afterwards. Together the panels show Mn and C enrichment with Fe and Al depletion at the intercritical ferrite / reverted austenite interface.
measured_quantities: atomic concentration of Fe, Mn, Al, Si, C (at.%)

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a 3DAP reconstruction of the analysed conical tip with a five-entry colour legend: Fe (pink), Mn (yellow), Al (cyan), Si (white), C (dark red), and a 200 nm scale bar at the bottom left.
The Z [nm] axis of (a) is labelled with ticks at −50, −100, −150, −200, −250 and −300 nm, and the lateral axes are labelled Y [nm] and X [nm].
In (a) a light-blue virtual cylinder runs along the Z axis inside the tip, and a black dashed line near Z ≈ −50 nm is drawn across the cylinder with a further dashed curve near Z ≈ −250 nm.
Panel (b) plots Concentration (atomic %) on the y-axis (0–80) against Distance (nm) on the x-axis (0–350), with five labelled curves: Fe %, Mn %, Al %, C % and Si %.
In (b) the Fe % curve is flat near 74 atomic% up to about 240 nm, drops sharply to about 65 atomic% at about 245 nm, and then rises to about 78 atomic% for the remaining distance.
In (b) the Mn % curve rises to a peak of about 18 atomic% at the same position (~245 nm) where Fe % drops, and then falls to about 6 atomic%.

In (b) the Al % curve sits near 11–12 atomic% before the interface, dips slightly at ~245 nm and then rises to ~14 atomic% after it, while the C % curve is low before the interface and changes sharply at it.

The caption states that (a) is a three-dimensional atom probe (3DAP) reconstructed image of all elements and (b) is the one-dimensional (1D) concentration profile along the virtual cylinder generated in Fig. 10a.
The citing text states that a 15 nm diameter virtual cylinder was generated inside the conical tip along the z axis for quantitative analysis.

The citing text states that the upper part of the cylinder (above the dashed line) is enriched in Mn and C compared with the lower part, defining an interface between intercritical ferrite and reverted austenite.
The citing text reports measured atomic concentrations in reverted austenite of Fe 72.92±0.33%, Mn 12.41±0.24%, Al 11.74±0.32%, Si 1.34±0.08% and C 1.59±0.09%.
The citing text reports measured atomic concentrations in intercritical ferrite (α-ferrite) of Fe 77.94±0.35%, Mn 5.65±0.36%, Al 14.41±0.14%, Si 1.76±0.12% and C 0.24±0.12%.
The citing text states the interface composition is ~65% Fe, ~18% Mn, ~11% Al, ~1.7% Si and 2.40% C, suggesting Mn and C enrichment with Fe and Al depletion at the grain boundary.

subfigures.description: 3DAP reconstruction of a conical atom-probe tip, Z [nm] axis from −50 to −300, lateral Y [nm] and X [nm] axes, element colour legend Fe (pink), Mn (yellow), Al (cyan), Si (white), C (dark red), and a 200 nm scale bar. A light-blue virtual cylinder runs along the Z axis; a dashed line near Z = −50 nm marks the interface and a second dashed curve sits near Z = −250 nm. Individual atom colours and the exact lateral tick assignment are only partially legible.

1D concentration profile of the virtual cylinder: x-axis Distance (nm) 0–350, y-axis Concentration (atomic %) 0–80, five curves (Fe %, Mn %, Al %, C %, Si %). Fe % is ~74 and flat until a sharp drop to ~65 at ~245 nm followed by a rise to ~78; Mn % spikes to ~18 at the same position then drops to ~6; Al % shows a dip then rises; C % shows a step up at the interface.
